column1: # Written BEFORE any S3R3 self-check run (this file is the expected-value record; it is not an S4 verification).
# Status: INFLUENCED (the RNV1 window structure was measured in R6d and S3R3 before this file, see RNV1_SOURCE_R6d.md section 4,
#   PRE_FIX_SOURCE_S3R3.md, and the gdb branch/malloc-line record gdb_tri_F_malloc_lines.log).
# Expected values are NOT changed after the runs.  Any later change is a new *_ERRATA file (AGENTS.md section 5).
#         F2 = the S3R3 tree (pattern.c with R3 repair + S4_internal.h comment); commit recorded after the fix commits.
# Library: -O0 -g builds (build/trees/F-dbg, build/trees/F2-dbg; sha256 recorded in build_notes.txt).
# SECTION A  RNV1 injection on F2 (36 F points of REGISTRY_S4_PRE_R6d_RNV1.tsv, the same point_ids and requests; two passes).
#   Expected class: REPORTED_FAILURE (rc non-zero, rc < 128, no signal), driver rc (RC first) non-zero, hit = 1.
#   Expected: 36 of 36 points REPORTED_FAILURE in pass 1 and pass 2.
#   Note on "72": the R6d F block has 36 points; two passes give 72 runs.  The brief's "72 F points" is read as 36 points x 2 passes.
#   Basis (source, [源码]): the three window mallocs (pattern.c:1477/1481 rect, 1251 cg) and the tri pair (1656/1660) now return -1.0 or -11
#   paths to pattern_generate_flow_field, which returns -11 (not 0 and not a NULL write).  NOT verified by run before this file.
#   Baseline (no injection) of each (mode,NG) is unchanged from R6d: nv NG1/5/9 0; vl NG1 20, NG5/9 0; fftnv NG1/5/9 0; fftvl NG1 20, NG5/9 0.
#   For vl NG1 and fftvl NG1 the REPORTED_FAILURE class is expected from the injection (rc1 = -11 path), not from the D016 path.
# SECTION A2  Return-code chain check (gdb, 2 points, one per injected M=1 and M=3 on F2 nv NG9):
#   Expected: the injected malloc returns NULL; the value -11 is returned by pattern_generate_flow_field;
#   The ComputeLayerModes step is recorded by the driver rc1 = 20 (see section A row checks) and by gdb frames.
# SECTION B  No-injection output identity, F vs F2 (dump files call1/call2/call3 via S4FMM_DUMP_DIR).
#   nv, vl, fftnv, fftvl x NG 1, 5, 9 (24 runs per tree).  Expected: IDENTICAL for every pair (byte equal).
#   vl NG1 and fftvl NG1: pattern returns -10 (D016) on BOTH F and F2; expected rc 20 on both; still IDENTICAL.
#   C1 (F, no injection): gdb must show pattern_generate_flow_field_tri entered; 3 window mallocs at pattern.c:1656, 1660, 1251 (cg).
#      Expected rc 0.  Measured in S3R3 step 3 (gdb_tri_F_malloc_lines.log); the expectation here is the window count of 3.
#   C2 (F and F2, injection at each of the 3 window mallocs, two passes): expected F = CRASH (rc >= 128) for all 3 points;
#      F2 = REPORTED_FAILURE for all 3 points.  Points: TRI-F-m1, TRI-F-m2, TRI-F-m3 (and the same on F2).
#   C3 (F vs F2, no injection, tri driver): byte-identical dump files.
# SECTION D  Smoke check (RS-177 nv/vl M-* points, one each; expected rc = R6c value).  Expected: same rc as R6c.
#   (Recorded in the smoke result file; the point list is taken from the R6c registry, see the S3R3 report.)
